scope: Frozen external MVTec residual1575 posthoc structured diagnostics

prompts.difference: External uses an industrial component; VisA uses its category description. Schema instructions are the same.

candle.user_text:
Image features: [[ANOMALY_BRIDGE_FEATURE_SLOT]]
This is a photo of a candle for anomaly detection. Is there any anomaly in the image?
Reply with exactly Yes or No on the first line. On the second line output one JSON object with only bbox and location. For No use {"bbox":null,"location":"none"}. For Yes, bbox is [x1,y1,x2,y2], integer coordinates from 0 to 1000 relative to image width and height; enclose all abnormal regions in one box. x1<x2 and y1<y2. location is the grid cell containing the box center, chosen from top_left, top_center, top_right, middle_left, middle_center, middle_right, bottom_left, bottom_center, bottom_right. Do not output any other text.
